styles.css:
& > .wp-block-accordion-heading .wp-block-accordion-heading__toggle-icon { font-size: 0; width: var(--wp--preset--spacing--40); height: var(--wp--preset--spacing--40); background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--rojo); -webkit-mask: url(/wp-content/uploads/contope-iconos/icono-mas.svg) center / contain no-repeat; mask: url(/wp-content/uploads/contope-iconos/icono-mas.svg) center / contain no-repeat; transform: none; }
&.is-open > .wp-block-accordion-heading .wp-block-accordion-heading__toggle-icon { -webkit-mask: url(/wp-content/uploads/contope-iconos/icono-menos.svg) center / contain no-repeat; mask: url(/wp-content/uploads/contope-iconos/icono-menos.svg) center / contain no-repeat; }
